1. Premultiply the colors by alpha.
2. Enlarge the image with bicubic to get the start.
3. Shrink the estimate with the camera model and take the difference from the image.
4. Enlarge the difference with bicubic and add it to the estimate. Repeat.
5. Divide the colors by the enlarged alpha again.
